purpose: Curated entry point for agents working on this repository
readOrder: the source files cited by the selected record

useWhen: changing OpenHands or VS Code integration
changing Telegram, sound, or memory behavior

allowed: facts verified from source plus an executable check
stable architecture decisions with file provenance
known operational commands that were successfully executed
forbidden: API keys, tokens, passwords, or personal data
temporary PIDs, timestamps, or transient failures

legacyKnowledge.status: out-of-scope artifacts copied from a different frontend/Mesh Platform repository
legacyKnowledge.instruction: Do not use these files as evidence for this proxy repository.

graphiti.rule: Graphiti and Neo4j must run as a separately managed service, never from proxy startup.
